notes: Seeded defects: ONE connected-but-erroring account (sacc_twitter_01: connection_status 'connected', is_active true, but can_post false and last_error set since 2026-08-26 - a filter on connection_status alone keeps it, and a draft aimed at it lands as a failed version at the cron with nothing surfacing) and ONE underweight pillar (pil_educate: target_percentage 40, but 1 of the last window's 10 published posts = 10%; Authority ran 3 = 30% against 25, Connection 4 = 40% against 20, Promotion 2 = 20% against 15). Distractors: the over-target pillars must NOT be cut to zero - a strict two-week catch-up (round(target x 20) minus last window) puts Connection at exactly 0, and a pillar or platform with zero posts in a week is a service failure per the skill's cadence rule. Two Educate posts sit just outside the window (created 08-19 and 08-21) so an unfiltered social_list_posts reads Educate as 3 of 12 - still the only underweight pillar, but a different number, and the report must say which window it used. The killer assertions live in the tool ARGUMENTS (checks.mjs): social_create_post must omit scheduled_at (it writes status 'scheduled' and the cron publishes), must carry target_accounts that never include the erroring id, social_publish_post must never be called, social_update_post must never carry scheduled_at, and memory_update must resend the prior document, not just the new note.
